description.value: Ramen Danbo is a Fukuoka-style Tonkotsu ramen chain whose Robson Street and Kitsilano shops were its first locations outside Japan, and it has since expanded across North America and the UK. Each bowl is highly customizable — riders can dial in noodle firmness, broth thickness, richness, and spice level — and a full vegan menu sits alongside the signature pork-bone broth options. Takeout and delivery make it a practical fueling stop in the heart of Vancouver's Robson Street corridor.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 18m; stands (5 spaces) at 28m; stands (2 spaces) at 30m. Total: 9 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active Fukuoka-style Tonkotsu ramen restaurant at the Robson Street location, corroborating the OSM address reference to 'Robson' among Vancouver locations. OSM 'takeaway: yes' and 'diet:vegan: yes' are both directly confirmed by the website ('Pickup and Delivery Available!' and an explicit 'Vegan Menu' tab on the Vancouver menu page). Neither the website nor OSM tags mention bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or device charging, so those remain null.
